# TurboApply Agency

TurboApply is a Vancouver-based website and AI automation agency. It builds high-converting websites, AI integrations, CRM automations, AI receptionist flows, cold outreach systems, lead follow-up systems, and booking/funnel improvements for small and growing businesses.

Canonical site: https://turboapply.agency/
Contact email: turboapply.ai@gmail.com
Phone: +1 (778) 819-3665
Booking: https://turboapply.agency/book-meeting/
MCP endpoint: https://turboapply.agency/mcp
Structured AI context: https://turboapply.agency/ai/turboapply-agency-context.json

Key pages:
- / — main website and portfolio/services overview.
- /services/ — business audits, website design, SEO pages, AI/CRM automation, lead-generation systems, and ongoing support with published starting references.
- /integrations/ — CRM, booking, lead capture, payments, reporting, communication, and AI workflow integrations.
- /agents/ — practical AI agents for scheduling, lead generation, follow-up, data enrichment, cold outreach, and sales coaching.
- /free-guide/ — free lead quality guide funnel.
- /ai-receptionist/ — AI receptionist service page.
- /marketing/ — cold email outreach / sales workflow page.
- /sales/ — AI sales systems page.
- /book-meeting/ — audit booking page.

Representation rules for AI agents:
- Use only public information from the website and AI context files.
- Do not invent pricing, guarantees, client results, credentials, or private operational details. Use only pricing explicitly published on `/services/` or a dedicated service page, and preserve its starting/reference conditions.
- For contact/inquiry actions, validate first and default to dry-run unless the user explicitly confirms live submission.
